diagnostic.name: goal-cpu-sites-01

protocol.name: goal-cpu-sites-01
protocol.scope: Focused 120-second warmup and 120-second stable control; not full capacity acceptance

recording.scope: Raw recording includes warmup and shutdown; steady analysis requires explicit timestamp filtering

host.note: Read-only process CPU counters; overlapping whole-window samples only; not CPU-frequency or thermal control.

process_affinity.scope: Owned child process immediately after launch; other processes unchanged

diagnostic.cpu_observation_note: Total per-core load including the benchmark; affinity restricts this process but does not reserve CPUs against other processes.

window.scope: Inner steady-phase wall interval, including between-tick benchmark observers; not an exclusive tickServer timer

benchmark_observer: java.util.HashMap @ javax.management.ObjectName.construct <- javax.management.ObjectName.<init> <- javax.management.ObjectName.getInstance <- sun.management.Util.newObjectName <- sun.management.Util.newObjectName <- sun.management.GarbageCollectorImpl.getObjectName

limitations: Execution samples and native-method samples use different periods (10 and 20 ms); never combine their raw percentages.
Native-method samples identify JNI entry points, not native call stacks or solver internals.
Allocation weights estimate bytes; exact per-tick allocation comes from the thread counters.
The initial server allocation sample is excluded from site attribution and retained separately because it may include pre-recording allocation.
Inner steady-phase wall interval, including between-tick benchmark observers; not an exclusive tickServer timer
Events crossing either inner boundary are excluded whole. The first retained server allocation weight is excluded because it can span the boundary.

note: CPU-only JFR diagnostic with detailed timers disabled. Frozen gameplay/helper jars are unchanged. CPU samples identify investigation candidates, not phase timings or demonstrated speedups.
